profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in bulky, stone-textured grey armor with green accents. Wears a red waist wrap, a long blue tabard, and carries a large grey kite shield.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern man with a thick brown beard and bushy mustache. Features narrowed, determined eyes and a weathered complexion, looking left.
profile.weapon_desc: Large silver crescent-bladed battle axe held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Warrior stands braced with the axe held high over the right shoulder and shield positioned left.
profile.step2_windup: Maintains the high-ready posture, tensing muscles to prepare for a heavy downward strike toward the upper-left direction.
profile.step3_impact: Swings the axe down forcefully. A massive, bright golden diagonal energy flash fills the upper-left area, marking the impact zone.
profile.step4_finish: The axe rests at the bottom of the arc while orange energy sparks linger in the air. The warrior begins shifting back to a defensive stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy flash in Frame 4 perfectly aligns with the diagonal downward swing path of the axe head toward the top-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference; motion and effects are consistently aligned.
